integrity_statement: 100% real verified Ethereum mainnet logs, live RPC eth_call state, and public DefiLlama/Curve API data; zero fabricated or synthetic data points.

notch_and_agency.primary_sample_definition: Primary notch-bunching sample restricts to batch managers with immutable on-chain minInterestRateChangePeriod < 604,800s (1h and 24h managers) who actually face the economic 168h cooldown fee notch, separating hardcoded 604,800s smart-contract revert walls.

dominated_region_agency_audit.fee_base_gain_scope_note: hikes_only covers the 345 positive-debt premature rate hikes (+$1,159.82/yr); all_paid also includes the 7 positive-debt premature cuts (+$1,191.72/yr).

batch_spike_and_cut_episodes.discount_convention_note: Canonical discount sq_discount_pct = 1 - (hike_fee + spike_window_excess_interest + cut_fee)/hold_7d_excess (84.02% wstETH M01; 60.96% WETH M03). Alternative cut-fee-only ratios sq_discount_cut_fee_vs_rem_pct (84.53%/61.33%) and sq_discount_cut_fee_vs_7d_pct (84.62%/61.56%) are recorded alongside.

panelC_exploratory_positive_debt_mgr_day.audit_note: Exploratory within-manager-day check restricted strictly to positive-debt manager-branch-days (89.3% of the naive 7-manager balanced grid had zero debt; only M08 and M10 hold positive debt across all 3 branches). Bartik 2SLS is null on Panel C and is NEVER conflated with OLS.

methodological_notes.ogata_integrals: Exact analytical piecewise integrals int_{t_{k-1}}^{t_k} (mu + g_red*R(s) + g_vol*V(s) + Hawkes(s)) ds (zero trapezoidal approximation error).
methodological_notes.free_kappa_red: Jointly profiles redemption decay half-life from 0.5 min to 24h in both M2 (null) and M3 (full), proving cross-manager contagion survives 6/6 branch-samples.
methodological_notes.alpha_self_1h_lock: MIN_INTEREST_RATE_CHANGE_PERIOD = 3,600s enforces 0 same-manager gaps <1h, constraining sub-hour self-excitation on WETH/wstETH while rETH exhibits 13.1% post-1h same-manager gaps in [1h,2h).

part2_gpv_structural_estimation.primary_estimator_note: Debt-weighted average within-(branch, day) cross-sectional quantile curve Q_bar(s), matching Theorem 1.1's daily queue equilibrium and eliminating the 3.1x-5.5x upward bias caused by pooling drifting macro rates across 485 days.

WETH.regime_shift_diagnosis: Evaluates out-of-sample queue spread above Confirmation's empirical front rate r_front_conf. Realized 77-day Confirmation redemption turnover fell sharply relative to Development while posted Confirmation rates rose, indicating forward-looking tail-risk pricing / macro rate shift.

sp_peg_elasticity_calibration.methodology_note: SP-to-debt ratios and weekly regressions are estimated strictly within-sample (zero Dev/Conf leakage). Weekly SP-APY regressions are statistically underpowered (Dev p=0.92, Pooled p=0.39), so GE counterfactuals report the full 5-point parametric elasticity grid eps_SP in {0.00, 0.25, 0.50, 1.00, 2.00}.

benchmark_footnotes: All Liquity V2 BOLD rows use exact debt-day weighted APRs and Replay-computed upfront fees across 485 days.

Primary table (`protocols`) uses apples-to-apples ongoing repricing-only fees (BatchUpdated op=2 vs unbatched op=3); `protocols_all_upfront_scope` includes origination/draw/join fees for both delegated (+0.253%/yr) and unbatched (+0.320%/yr).
Design A* GE and Design D GE show Status Quo BOLD peg RMSE (22.93 bp) and rate SD (1.18%) strictly as ceteris paribus reference values.
Liquity V1 LUSD 0.526% reflects a one-time minting fee annualized at a 1-year holding horizon (2.10%/yr at 3 months; 0.26%/yr at 2 years).
Curve crvUSD rows report nominal borrow APR only and exclude unobserved path-dependent LLAMMA soft-liquidation rebalancing losses.

Sky Jug.ilks rates are exact compounded APY (Jug.base == 0); Aave V3 rates are nominal APR (GHO is base rate prior to stkAAVE/Merit discounts). Non-BOLD rows omit wallet gas (~4-8 bp/yr), which is conservative against BOLD.

liquity_v2_friendly_fork_ecosystem.peak_methodology_note: simultaneous_peak_*_tvl_usd sums TVL across all verified Liquity V2 friendly forks on the exact same UTC calendar day; sum_peak_*_tvl_usd sums each protocol's individual non-simultaneous peak TVL.
